name: Row-based Crops Navigation & Perception Simulation Dataset
description: Service robotics is recently enhancing precision agriculture enabling many automated processes based on efficient autonomous navigation solutions. However, data generation and infield validation campaigns hinder the progress of large-scale autonomous platforms. Simulated environments and deep visual perception are spreading as successful tools to speed up the development of robust navigation with low-cost RGB-D cameras. In this context, the contribution of this work is twofold: a synthetic dataset to train deep semantic segmentation networks together with a collection of virtual scenarios for a fast evaluation of navigation algorithms. Moreover, an automatic parametric approach is developed to explore different field geometries and features. The simulation framework and the dataset have been evaluated by training a deep segmentation network on different crops and benchmarking the resulting navigation.
reputation: A focused synthetic dataset and simulation suite used in precision-agriculture and robotics research; useful for rapid prototyping though not yet widely adopted outside the domain.
notes: Synthetic dataset with potential sim-to-real domain gap; primarily evaluated in simulation (limited real-world validation); non-LLM benchmark; performance varies strongly by crop/scene and model capacity.
